thread:
marta_support: Flagging a live issue: since ~06:10 UTC several new EU customers attempting SSO SAML onboarding are getting 401/invalid-assertion. Looks correlated to our recent IdP cert rotation. Collecting impacted tenants now.

rishi_sre: confirmed. IdP pushed a new cert at 06:05 UTC but our SP metadata cache didn't refresh for a subset of regions. some assertion sigs failing validation.

theo_eng: putting a hotfix in to force metadata refresh and accept the new cert for 30m grace window. will need a deploy (no db changes).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: hotfix/refresh-sp-metadata -> staging -> prod (rolling) 
Bridge: https://bridge/INC-20260322-SSO

amanda_acctmgr: we have 14 accounts in EU region currently onboarding (4 paid, 6 trials, 4 enterprise). Trials are most time-sensitive. I can reach out once we know ETA.

marta_support: please do. Also need to surface a clear message for customers who got a 401 during SSO setup — they often retry and think the config is wrong.

elaine_cs: draft customer note below. Want a brief public note + tailored enterprise variant. Trying to avoid confusion and unnecessary config changes on the customer side.

elaine_cs: customer template:
```
Hi <customer>,\nWeobserved a disruption affecting SSO SAML onboarding in EU region between 06:05and 06:28 UTC. This caused some SSO attempts to fail with "invalid assertion" or 401 responses. Our engineers have deployed a temporary fix to refresh service metadata; you should be able to complete SSO setup now.\nNo changes are required on your IdP configuration. If you continue to see failures, please reply and we'll open a dedicated support session. Weapologize for the disruption and will follow up with a full RCA and any compensation details by EOD.\n```

marta_support: enterprise variant should mention dedicated troubleshooting call + SLA acknowledgement.

amanda_acctmgr: I can offer 1:1 setup sessions for the 4 enterprise accounts and fast-track support tickets. Should we proactively schedule?

nisha_pm: agree on session offer. For compensation, propose: trials = 1-day credit, paid = 3% credit if impacted >30m, enterprise = case-by-case credit + onboarding session. Finance ok? @finance

finance: we can approve the proposed credits; send list and well create manual adjustments.

rishi_sre: update: hotfix deployed to EU region at 06:20 UTC; metadata refresh completed. telemetry shows SSO failure rate back to baseline (~0.2%).

theo_eng: rolling check: affected tenant queue drained, replays running for failed assertions. will monitor for 1 hour. posting logs to internal link: https://internal/logs/sso-refresh (redacted).

elaine_cs: great. I'll start outbound to trials and paid impacted tenants now with the template. Amanda please start scheduling enterprise calls; Marta to attach impacted tenant CSV to the outbound.

amanda_acctmgr: scheduling enterprise calls now. pinging customers with calendar invites + support link.

marta_support: uploading CSV: https://drive/placeholder-sso-impacted.csv. DMing enterprise contacts to AMs.

elaine_cs: plan for follow-up RCA: owners: comms = @elaine_cs, mitigation = @theo_eng & @rishi_sre, RCA doc = @nisha_pm. Will include timeline, root cause (metadata cache TTL + rotation race), and proposed mitigation (auto-refresh on cert rotate + alerting).

theo_eng: proposed permanent fix: add cert-rotation webhook from IdP to invalidate cache + shorter TTL for SP metadata during rotation windows. also add health metric for assertion validation error spike.

rishi_sre: also recommending a runbook: on IdP rotate, if failure rate >1% for 5m, auto-trigger metadata refresh and page infra.

elaine_cs: final note to customers will include credit mechanics and how they'll receive adjustments. I'll loop finance once we finalize account list.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-20260322-02 SSO onboarding failures (EU). Severity: P3. Bridge: https://bridge/INC-20260322-SSO

amanda_acctmgr: thanks team. sending enterprise follow-ups now. will report back any lingering failures.
